00050 : UGenInternal(NumInputs),

00062 
00063 void PauseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00064 {
00065   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00066   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00067   
00068   float currentLevel = *(inputs[Level].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00069   
00070   if(currentLevel == 0.f && prevLevel == 0.f)
00071   {
00072 #ifdef UGEN_VDSP
00073     vDSP_vclr(outputSamples, 1, numSamplesToProcess);
00074 #else
00075     memset(outputSamples, 0, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00076 #endif
00077   }
00078   else
00079   {
00080     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00081     
00082     if(currentLevel != prevLevel)
00083     {
00084       float inc = (currentLevel - prevLevel) / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00085       float level = prevLevel;
00086       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00087       {
00088         *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples++ * level;
00089         level += inc;
00090       }
00091     }
00092     else
00093     {
00094 #ifdef UGEN_VDSP
00095       float zero = 0.f;
00096       vDSP_vsmsa(inputSamples, 1, &currentLevel, &zero, outputSamples, 1, numSamplesToProcess);
00097 #else
00098       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00099       {
00100         *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples++ * currentLevel;
00101       }
00102 #endif
00103     }
00104   }
00105   
00106   prevLevel = currentLevel;
00107 }

00109 Pause::Pause(Pause_InputsWithTypesOnly) throw()
00110 {
00111   UGen inputs[] = { Pause_InputsNoTypes };
00112   const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputChannels(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);
00113   initInternal(numInputChannels);
00114   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00115   {
00116     internalUGens[i] = new PauseUGenInternal(Pause_InputsNoTypes);
00117     internalUGens[i]->initValue(input.getValue(i) * level.getValue(i));
00118   }
00119 }
